sources.title: 黄耀儀《文学者西川満の日本天后会における幸福観》東アジア研究34

sources.title: 秋生真里 2026-04-13 西川流十大主星及1972著作回顾
sources.quality_notes: Reports 1972 book, names 陽占/陰占, 三柱, 北落師門/調舒星 comparison, and names of other stars; modern reading and author's interpretation not original pages. Title differs in 運命/命運 from controlling NDL 1972 record; no same-print identity, verified teacher chain, source mechanical replay, or proof of Ziwei/Bazi identity.
